about: findingCommentId(markId, findingId) as apps/app/src/server/store.ts computes it (DEC-053): the id of the comment a finding becomes. The rule: SHA-256 over the UTF-8 bytes of the mark's id, one line feed (U+000A, the byte 0x0A), and the finding's id, with nothing before or after; the first 40 characters of the digest in lowercase hexadecimal (its first 20 bytes); prefixed with "f_", 42 characters in all. An id (Id: letters, digits, _ and -, at most 64) never holds a line feed, so the separator cannot be confused with either id: m_a + bc and m_ab + c, and m_a- + x and m_a + -x, give different ids. The same finding id on two marks gives two ids. It pins the function for the re-sends of installed extensions up to 0.4.0, whose findings arrive as comments. The extension makes the same id too (its findingCommentId in src/lib/case.ts, extension DEC-081): its store's upgrade turns each finding of a mark into a comment with this id, made from the mark's id in that browser, and removes again the comments of the findings its team's server has, whose own comments then arrive with the sync.
